seo.title: The Luttrell · Furnished student rooms on Channing Way, Berkeley
seo.description: Furnished private and shared rooms at 2328 Channing Way, Berkeley. About five minutes on foot to campus. Now leasing Spring and Fall 2027.

hero.alt: The Luttrell at 2328 Channing Way: the restored 1889 yellow Victorian house with the new five-story building behind it.

intro.headline: Modern Living. Historic Charm.
intro.subhead: A New Standard in Berkeley Student Living.
intro.body: Brand-new apartments paired with the timeless character of a historic Victorian home. A distinctive off-campus living experience designed for UC Berkeley students.

rooms.heading: Floor plans
rooms.body:
Fully Furnished Rooms

Every room comes fully furnished for your convenience.

Private Room: Includes one full-size or Twin XL bed, a desk, an office chair, two 2-drawer chests, and a wardrobe.

Shared Room: Each resident is provided with one Twin XL bed, a desk, an office chair, two 2-drawer chests, and a wardrobe.

image.alt: Furnished floor plan, Type 1: kitchen with dining table, bathroom with tub, shared Bedroom 1 with two twin beds and desks, private Bedroom 2 with a full bed and desk.
Furnished floor plan, Type 2 – Shared: kitchen with dining table, bathroom with tub, shared Bedroom 1 with two twin beds and desks, private Bedroom 2 with a full bed and desk.
Furnished floor plan, Type 2 – Private: kitchen with dining table, bathroom with tub, study nook, and three private bedrooms, each with a full bed, desk and wardrobe.
Furnished floor plan, Type 3: kitchen and dining area, two bathrooms with tubs, and four private bedrooms, each with a full bed, desk and wardrobe.

Furnished floor plans of the Luttrell House. First floor: entry, stairs, Bedroom 1, Bath 1, kitchen, living and dining. Second floor: shared Bedroom 2 with two twin beds, Bedrooms 3 and 4, Baths 2 and 3.

rooms.disclaimer: Floor plans are artist's renderings and all dimensions are approximate. Actual products, features, and specifications may vary in size or detail. Not all features are available in every rental home. Prices and availability are subject to change without notice.
rooms.note:
2027 Fall Monthly Rates

Shared-bedroom rates are listed per person in a two-person room. All rates are based on a 12-month lease. Spring specials are also available.

history.heading: The Luttrell House
history.body: The front house was built in 1889 for Captain James F. and Cecilia M. Luttrell. It is a City of Berkeley historic resource, restored and now paired with the new building behind it.
